ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 70% high-intensity (white/light-grey) to 30% low-intensity (black) pixels across the visible ventral fluke surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-intensity pixels dominate the lateral lobes. Low-intensity pixels form a concentrated contiguous mass at the central notch/peduncle connection, with irregular, high-contrast mottling extending along the trailing edges and a distinct dark cluster on the medial base of the left lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: V-shaped central depression with a calculated angle of approximately 105 degrees and a depth ratio of ~1:8 relative to total fluke width.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Moderate-frequency serration along both lobes; left lobe exhibits higher pixel-amplitude peaks (jaggedness) at the mid-trailing edge; right lobe shows more consistent, lower-amplitude variations.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: The trailing edge follows a generally convex trajectory from the notch to the distal tips, with a slight upturn at the terminal ends of each lobe.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Small cluster of circular dark-pixel anomalies (~3-5 spots) visible on the distal posterior region of the right lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Presence of several thin, dark-pixel linear streaks (rake marks) oriented horizontally across the mid-section of the left lobe.

other_distinctive_markers: Unique isolated dark pigmentation band located at the extreme distal tip of the left lobe, detached from the primary central pigment mass.
